dispatchPrinciple: Dispatch independent leaf packages immediately up to actual executor capacity. All UI leaves have zero hard start dependencies. Backend/OS/provider/candidate outputs gate only the actual consumer operation or final proof phase. Parallelize WIN10/WIN11/MAC/WEB lanes independently; neither Windows nor Web waits for macOS acceptance.
executionStatus: This file allocates work; it does not claim237 agents, target runners or provider operations are already running. Root executor records actual dispatch/resources.

commonContracts.newChanges: Record proposed additive DTO/capability/receipt deltas in package artifact; coordinate owner. No all-UI wait for authority or final global freeze.
commonContracts.dirtyWipPolicy: Read-only review/fixture work starts immediately. Copy/adopt only into isolated candidate using approved immutable snapshots; preserve original dirty checkout. Final integrated evidence requires the adopted commit/hash, not WIP path existence.
